$schema-note: Single source of truth for which public packages the automated npm release lane publishes. Every package under packages/ with a public publishConfig must appear in exactly one of enrolled/excluded, so adding a publishable package is a deliberate release decision instead of a silent one. Enforced by scripts/npm-release-plan.mjs (bun run check:npm-release).

excluded.packages/harness: Never published to npm and no enrolled package depends on it at runtime. npm OIDC cannot perform a first publish, so enrolling it requires a one-time owner-authenticated bootstrap first.
excluded.packages/queue-contracts: Never published to npm and no enrolled package depends on it at runtime. npm OIDC cannot perform a first publish, so enrolling it requires a one-time owner-authenticated bootstrap first.
